//: DocLink target switch. Change "target" to "mock" or "real", save this file, then reload DocLink in chrome://extensions. No other file needs to change and no command needs to run.
//recon: Save to: Recon (S3). reconBaseUrl = the Recon Engine API (its origin must also be in manifest.json host_permissions); reconCustomerId = the Recon customer the files belong to; reconAppUrl (optional) = the page 'Open Recon Engine' opens for sign-in, defaults to reconBaseUrl.
//okta: Recon Engine sign-in with Okta (the second login, after IREPS). DocLink opens this Okta app through chrome.identity; register the redirect https://<extension id>.chromiumapp.org/okta in the Okta app (DocLink's sign-in page shows the exact value). The client SECRET never goes here: the Recon backend exchanges the code. enabled=false hides the Okta button.
